author: ZombieTron
body:
I'm always surprised when British stars are known in other parts of the world, so I'm not surprised you haven't heard of Jonathan Ross, he is our answer to Jay Leno/David Letterman/Conan O'brien if you have heard of them.

I watched on Friday and I was highly entertained, especially by the look on Vin Diesel's face when he heard how good Wossy's wife is at WoW. 🙂

subject: Don't let Vin Diesel put you off
author: ZombieTron
body:
Although there are cut scenes with acting in them, which it doesn't look like you can skip, the game itself has you tearing around in a car so you can't tell it's Vin Diesel at the wheel most of the time.

I quite like Vin Diesel tho, especially in Pitch Black (or maybe only in Pitch Black).
